<b>Beastflies</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are aggressive flies of [[Pharloom]]'s lowlands that ram prey with their hardbone mask.<ref>Beastfly [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Aggressive fly of Pharloom's lowlands. Rams prey with its hardbone mask."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Will move towards [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] when it sees her and then charges horizontally in a straight line. Beastflies may collide with the environment or with each other while charging.

Beastflies hover out of range before charging, but they can be jumped over and hit with downward attacks. They can also be baited into charging over Hornet's head, allowing her to hit them as they pass by.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Beastflies have their health quadrupled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== Location ==
Beastflies can be found primarily in [[the Marrow]], but they also appear in the [[Far Fields]], [[Memorium]], [[Deep Docks]], and the [[Chapel of the Beast]] within [[Hunter's March]], where they can also be summoned by a [[Savage Beastfly]].

After clearing the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/The Marrow 1|gauntlet]] in the Marrow, a Beastfly appears upon revisiting the arena.
